note: Weekly tokens (prompt+completion) routed through OpenRouter, weeks start Monday 00:00 UTC. Each week lists the top 9 models plus "others" (everything else), so the sum is the whole-platform total. ids are OpenRouter model ids from /api/v1/models where the ranking permaslug could be joined (":free" variants kept separate), otherwise the permaslug without its date suffix. First week is truncated (the chart is a trailing 1-year window). Last week is partial; forecastT reproduces the page's forecast bar at cachedAt.
